pr_body:
This PR will replace usage of the scroll API in the SQL module with the new point-in-time API.

Closes #61873
pr_title: SQL: Replace the scroll with PIT for data batching
pr_comment: Hi @bpintea, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

review_comment:
`setTrackTotalHits(true)` call is effectively discarded by subsequent `setSource(source)`.
While this could be fixed in another PR, it being ignored seems harmless (and thus #52787 could be closed by this issue as well).
This is no longer required, the SearchHit cursor wasn't properly auto-closed on result set exhaustion, but it is now.
Change done to compact the expression and match the similar construct in the constructor (above).
